name: fcc-spectrum-mcp-server
description: FCC radio spectrum licensing from the Universal Licensing System: search callsigns and licenses, licensed frequencies, and transmitter locations.

FCC_SPECTRUM_MIRROR_DIR.title: Index directory
FCC_SPECTRUM_MIRROR_DIR.description: Absolute path of the directory holding the local ULS index (built once with the mirror:init script). Blank uses .mirror/fcc-uls under the working directory.

FCC_SPECTRUM_SERVICES.title: Service groups
FCC_SPECTRUM_SERVICES.description: Comma list of weekly ULS service groups to index. Blank uses the default set (LMpriv, LMcomm, LMbcast, micro, cell, market, paging, coast, mdsitfs, amat).

FCC_SPECTRUM_REDACT_INDIVIDUALS.title: Redact individual licensees
FCC_SPECTRUM_REDACT_INDIVIDUALS.description: Only false, 0, no, or off disables redaction of individual licensees; blank keeps it on.

FCC_SPECTRUM_BASE_URL.title: ULS bulk host
FCC_SPECTRUM_BASE_URL.description: ULS bulk file host root, used only when building or refreshing the index. Blank uses https://data.fcc.gov/download/pub/uls.
